en.about-p1: I'm a Backend Developer with 1 year of experience at LPSE (Government Electronic Procurement Agency). I focus on building clean, scalable, and reliable web applications using PHP, Laravel, and modern JavaScript ecosystem.
en.about-p2: Currently pursuing a degree in Information Systems at Universitas Terbuka (on hold). Open to new job opportunities.

en.lpse-li4: Contributed to the development of the CariKatalog system for procurement data management
en.lpse-li5: Developed REST APIs for downloading product data from e-Katalog version 5 and 6, used in the CekLPSE system
en.lpse-li6: Optimized application performance and database queries to improve system efficiency
